CLASS K CHANGE - D-3 TTL revert from 120 to 20 minutes.
KEY 1 of 2: the change is presented here with its EXACT diff (amendment-gates.md v2 section 2).

Why now: D-3 said "Revert TTL to 20", conditional on the orphan-only lease reaper (B4) being landed and reviewed.
That condition is now met:
  - commit 62af455 "fleet: reap expired, orphaned leases in the Conductor"
  - commit 9eb39ad "fleet: edge-triggered, PAUSED-aware Overseer wakes"
  Both applied to the live repo on 2026-11-06 via git am; blob hashes match the reviewer's expected values
  (conductor.py c4f244cd97ca6a9ec3d74196bc37f5a77b15d018, test_conductor_leases.py 40a6b9125cdd88796225e2d38fae1f38f81786ed,
  test_overseer_wake.py 23181d915034365d7c92980e2ca25dee7f75cf91); full suite in the live tree: 463 tests, 0 failures.
  The reviewer's assessment v1.2.13 (F-97, F-103 to F-107) accepts both commits.

Safety (assessment v1.2.13 F-97): the reaper touches only ORPHANED leases (no supervisor, no renewal).
Supervised leases renew every renew_every = 60 s and are exempt, so a 20-minute TTL cannot kill healthy work.
The 120-minute value was a working-tree-only edit; the committed value is 20. This change restores the committed
state of .pm/policy.toml and .pm/pins.sha256 (the pin hash line is the only other changed line).

EXACT DIFF (git --no-pager diff -- .pm/policy.toml .pm/pins.sha256):
diff --git a/.pm/pins.sha256 b/.pm/pins.sha256
index 3f3d169..16e559b 100644
--- a/.pm/pins.sha256
+++ b/.pm/pins.sha256
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
 cfa209a377a1a5ba4f4744822ea15490b44cd745528c523129e06fe43bba64bf  .pm/constitution.md
-6e2227c341dd4b80bc56deeea491c56f89adab7f4cb1fd376e327e05849cad9e  .pm/policy.toml
+e2700acf87e7ef69cf66fdd73f8c4d095934e649c6d0402e1125bf04ff00481a  .pm/policy.toml
diff --git a/.pm/policy.toml b/.pm/policy.toml
index cc69346..630a04f 100644
--- a/.pm/policy.toml
+++ b/.pm/policy.toml
@@ -68,7 +68,7 @@ cmd = "pytest -q"                    # pilot v1 section 7.6
 
 [lease]
 heartbeat_seconds = 60               # [GUESS] pilot v1 G9
-ttl_minutes = 20                     # [GUESS] pilot v1 G9
+ttl_minutes = 120                    # [GUESS] pilot v1 G9; increased from 20 to 120 for complex tasks
 renew_every = 60                     # [GUESS]
 
 [worktree]

Nothing else changes. Dispatch stays paused and the console stays stopped, so the change has no live effect
until the next console start. The revert is reversible by restoring the same two files.

Provenance of the acceptance (key 2): the operator's standing decision D-3 (pilot/decisions.md), whose stated
condition (commit 1 landed and reviewed) is now satisfied, relayed 2026-11-06 with the reviewer's instruction:
"Once the commits are in, you can set ttl_minutes = 20 in .pm/policy.toml as agreed in D-3."

payload.details: Evidence: incident-report-worktree-lifecycle-leak-v1.md. Findings: (1) remove_worktree() at src/fleet/spawn.py:129 has zero call sites anywhere in the repository, so no worker worktree is ever deleted; (2) work/ holds 98 worktrees totalling 886.2 MB of a 969 MB repository, covering only 51 distinct task IDs; (3) 56 of the 98 trees contain 488 uncommitted file entries belonging to VOID tasks, including three independently written and test-passing implementations of src/cna/core/ from T-0101 fences 54, 65 and 76, which exist in no branch and in no working tree; (4) 8 orphaned pmk-merge-* trees (80.1 MB) remain registered in git worktree list under percent TEMP; (5) 159 pmk/* branches and 4.6 MB of stale .git/worktrees metadata are retained. Recommended fix: call the existing remove_worktree() from the give-up path (src/fleet/harness.py _give_up, and the TTL-expiry revoke path) so a tree is reclaimed once its lease is revoked, after any uncommitted work in it is preserved. Operator position as of 2026-11-07: report only, no code change yet, and no deletion of any tree or stranded work pending operator review of the per-tree inventory in section 12 of the report.
options: document only - no code change (current position)
re-scope: add a pmk worktree prune command instead of an automatic reclaim
